3. Applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No. 0112 of 2019, U/S 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act,

sentences.text: 4. As per prosecution story, the applicant, who happens to be the husband of the deceased person, is stated to have subjected her to cruelty for a demand of dowry, as such, he is stated to have strangulated her to death on 1.4.2019.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case with a view to cause unnecessary harassment and to victimize him.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: The applicant has nothing to do with the said offence.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: The statement of P.W. 1- first informant has been recorded.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel has next stated that that as per the statement of the informant P.W. 1, he has categorically stated that the applicant had informed him of the death of the deceased person by hanging.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel has stated that there is no likelihood of the conclusion of trial in the near future.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: 6. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is further stated that there is no criminal history of the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: The applicant is languishing in jail since 14.4.2019.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: 7. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application on the ground that the said allegation itself stands falsified from the fact that the death of the deceased has been caused by strangulation and not by hanging, which negates the said story, whereby the statement of P.W. 1 is intact and he has categorically reiterated the allegations levelled in the FIR.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The applicant being the husband, is the main accused person, as his wife has expired within the precincts of his house and the prosecution has successfully proved the other ingredients of Section 304-B IPC.
8.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties, nature of offence, evidence on record, pending trial and considering the complicity of accused, severity of punishment, at this stage, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: 9. The bail application is, accordingly, rejected.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: 10. However, it is directed that the court below may proceed with the trial and reach at the logical conclusion expeditiously, if there is no legal impediment, within a period of one year from the date of production of a certified copy of this order.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: 11. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: Further, post mortem report however suggests that at the time of incident deceased was pregnant and however in general a pregnant lady does not think about to commit suicide but considering the fact that immediately after the incident when applicant came to know about the death of his wife due to drowning then he himself consumed poison and after treatment he could only be survived, his innocence at this stage cannot be ruled out.

sentences.text: 15. Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail for last more than a year.

As per prosecution story, the marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the deceased person as per Hindu Rites on 18.05.2022, and subsequent to it, the applicant and other family members are stated to have subjected the victim to cruelty for demand of dowry, thereby leading her to death on 02.08.2023 at about 04:00 AM.

sentences.text: The inquest was prepared well before the institution of FIR and the applicant was present at the time of said proceeding.

sentences.text: 9. A perusal of the file indicates that the FIR has been exhibited as Exhibit KA-2 that too by the prosecution witness No.2 on 29.04.2023, as such, there is every possibility that some more witnesses might have been examined, as such, argument of the counsel for the applicant that only one witness has been examined stands falsified.
